summary: Well-executed, narrowly scoped preregistered paired study that is reproducible and artifact-backed. The shared-candidate generate–verify–repair estimand is operationally motivated; the experiment and deterministic validator/repair design are documented and archived. Main weakness is limited inferential value caused by a near-ceiling baseline (199/200) and a paired design that by construction greatly reduces opportunities for repair; the manuscript should add a small set of clarifying, artifact-extractable details to improve interpretability and auditability.
critical_issues: The manuscript omits a concise, aggregated difficulty-level distribution (counts across the 200 confirmatory intents) that is needed to interpret the curated bank’s challenge level; this summary is available in the archived execution/task_manifest.jsonl and must be included in the paper.

The paper does not include a brief, auditable summary of the single repaired episode (task id, validator violation code(s), deterministic repair transformation applied, and why the mapping was unique); that information is present in the archived validator and repair traces and must be reported inline.

The presentation should explicitly state the practical consequence of the preregistered power assumption violation (baseline ≈0.5 assumed versus observed baseline ≈0.995) in one short paragraph in Results or Threats to Validity; although discussed, the paper must state this as a formal post-hoc limitation of the confirmatory inference rather than only as interpretation.
required_revisions: Add a one-paragraph aggregate summary (table or short sentence) listing counts of difficulty labels (e.g., very_hard/hard/medium/easy) across the 200 confirmatory intents, extracted from execution/task_manifest.jsonl, and cite the artifact SHA-256.

Add a short, auditable exemplar paragraph for the single repaired episode: report the task identifier, validator.violation_codes, the deterministic repair rule(s) applied (in the operator’s canonical names: insertion/reordering/preservation), and show the before/after normalized_configuration snippets or provide their artifact paths and SHA-256 hashes.

Add a concise formal statement in Results or Threats to Validity that the preregistered power calculation assumed baseline≈0.5 and that the observed baseline≈0.995 reduces sensitivity to the preregistered 0.15 absolute-effect target; quantify (from archived analysis artifacts) that discordant-pair counts were n=1 and explain how that limits confirmatory inference (i.e., limited potential discordants and hence reduced power).
optional_revisions: Include in the manuscript (or a compact appendix within pages 1–5) the exact master prompt text or a short, clearly labeled excerpt plus the provided SHA-256 (the repository path is given but an inline excerpt improves reader inspection), provided this does not violate page constraints.

Briefly discuss (one paragraph) the expected yield and cost trade-off if the same study were run under an independent-resampling estimand (2+ initial generations per intent), with numeric accounting already available in the execution manifest (model_calls_used) to illustrate cost scaling.

Consider adding a one-line reminder to the Abstract that the confirmatory bank is synthetic/curated and that external generalization is limited (already in Limitations, but useful for readers who scan only the abstract).
